validity.recommendation: Do NOT fill StartYear1 with the wiki's '2025' -- per the same page, that date is the target in-service date of the Westbound Compression Expansion Project, which the wiki text itself locates ON the Overthrust line ('infrastructure upgrades on the Overthrust line') but as a $120M COMPRESSION upgrade, not the original pipeline construction; carrying it onto this row's StartYear1 would misrepresent a decades-old mainline as having entered service in 2025. Leave StartYear1 blank rather than fill it with that date. The best lead found for the ORIGINAL Overthrust Pipeline is a Trailblazer-era 88-mile 'Overthrust Segment' (Whitney Canyon to Rock Springs, WY) that Mountain Fuel Resources designed, constructed and operated, targeted for October 1982 completion -- but this 88-mile figure does not clearly match this row's 261-mile Whitney Canyon-to-Wamsutter Overthrust Gas Pipeline, and Questar Pipeline's own SEC 10-K filings document later, separately dated expansions of the Overthrust system (a Kern River interconnection placed in service Jan 1, 2006; a Rock Springs-Wamsutter compression expansion completed Dec 2009; a 43-mile 36-inch loop from Rock Springs to Cabin 31 completed Feb 2011), so no single year cleanly represents the current 261-mile configuration. A human researcher should pull Questar Overthrust Pipeline Co.'s FERC Form 2 or Questar Pipeline's earliest SEC 10-Ks (EDGAR CIK 0000764044) to establish an original in-service year for the full current route before this is stageable as a fill.
validity.researcher_notes: Read the gem.wiki MountainWest Gas Pipeline page for leads only (never cited as a ref, per standing rule 1): 'The year 2025 is associated with the Westbound Compression Expansion Project ... Target in-service date of Q4 2025. Construction began in February 2025 ... involving infrastructure upgrades on the Overthrust line with a $120 million budget' -- confirming the wiki_alignment candidate is a compression-upgrade date, not this segment's commissioning. Searched for the Overthrust Pipeline's original construction year: found an 88-mile 'Overthrust Segment' (Mountain Fuel Resources, Whitney Canyon to Rock Springs, WY, part of the Trailblazer Pipeline project, targeted for October 1982 completion) via referenceforbusiness.com / encyclopedia.com company-history summaries (not cited -- single non-independent tertiary source, and the 88-mile figure does not match this row's 261-mile length, so not proposed as a fill). Searched Questar Pipeline Co. 10-K filings on SEC EDGAR (CIK 0000764044) via web search and found later, dated Overthrust-system expansions -- Kern River interconnection in service Jan 1, 2006; Rock Springs-Wamsutter compressor expansion completed Dec 2009 (new compressor station at Point of Rocks plus an addition at Rock Springs); a 43-mile, 36-inch-diameter loop from Rock Springs to Cabin 31/Blacksfork completed Feb 2011 -- none of which establishes a single original in-service year for the whole 261-mile line as it exists today. Given the ambiguity between the 88-mile 1982 segment and the current 261-mile configuration, and no independently corroborated single year, StartYear1 is left UNRESOLVED.
